title: Kramer 84, Left-Handed, Eruption Red Satin, Exclusive

long_description.title: We Updated the Features but Kept the In-Your-Face Attitude
long_description.body: The Kramer 84 honors Kramer’s first Golden Age and is one of the most influential electric guitars of all time. This updated version has more in common with the 80s-era originals than ever, including a new headstock rear stinger that matches the body and front headstock finish, a new direct-to-body mounted Kramer USA Eruption T humbucker™ pickup that Gibson Master Luthier Jim DeCola designed, and even a new retro-style volume knob. Of course, we kept the classic features like the lightweight alder body, 84 Banana headstock, and Floyd Rose® 1000 series tremolo, but now the R2 locking nut is rear-mounted, just like in the 80s. And it’s a Kramer, so you know we kept the in-your-face, Made to Rock Hard attitude. A premium gig bag is also included.

Neck Specs.Neck Material: One-piece Hard Maple with Walnut Skunk Stripe

Electronics Specs.Controls: Master Volume with Push/Pull Series/Parallel Switch

Misc Specs.Headstock: 84 Non-angled Big Banana, Wrench Holder on Rear
